item.tib: sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las lho rdza mched gsum gyi zhu lan
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ 'gu btsun shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi (gyis)/ yang yang bskul ma byas nas su/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa la/ mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthu dpal gyis/ 'phrul ngag bden pa g.yung drung bon/ dar rgyas 'phel nas 'gro ba'i don/ bstan pa rin chen rab brtan cing / phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du/ bkra shis bde legs ldan par shog/
